Criterion: Verify that ground firefighting access provisions are compatible with standard ground firefighting systems and that fire suppression can be accomplished through this access provision. Standard: Access to fire zones is provided to permit ground firefighting crews to extinguish a fire on the ground. Method of Compliance: Analysis verifies the location and interface requirements of ground firefighting provisions. Demonstration on the aircraft verifies that ground firefighting access provisions are compatible with standard ground firefighting systems.
